error[ZBX-E0550]: the source cannot be packed into an image
  while  packing an image
  cause  'no-such-image' cannot be packed: the store has no build result, image
         or tree by that name
  source no-such-image
  fix    list what the store keeps:   zbx store ls
  more   zbx explain E0550
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0550.html
